items.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
items.summary: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin's round trip to $85,000 burns traders on both sides

items.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
items.summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims' claims to the coins.
